The main takeaway from our work is that

, in the context of multivariate Randomized Block design, nonparametric permutation tests can be used as a valid alternative for the analysis of categorical variables, and they can be used as an alternative to parametric tests, even if the normality assumption holds.

the permutation test can be used to test the equality of the treatment means in the multivariate RCB design in case of categorical variables, even when the underlying distribution is not normal and when there are ordered categorical variables.
